fields.title: Finished books remain visible until the reader archives them
fields.description: A 91-word text was saved at 91/91, kept on disk and in the register, yet excluded from every library display group. Diagnose first-open completion separately from the proven visibility hole.
fields.notes: Owner smoke intake 2026-10-26. Proposed priority P1. Sources F14. Acceptance/evidence: docs/planning/roadmap-reviews/2026-10-26-smoke-triage.md. Stub; investigation/specification required. Release hold unchanged.
fields.deliverable: A completed, unarchived read remains findable in All until an explicit archive decision. Confirmed archived reads appear in Archive. Declining or dismissing confirmation never hides the read; no reset, forced completion or silent archive workaround.
